description:
Extend the life of your French Country crib with the Full Bed Rail Kit. This complete conversion set transforms your crib into a full-size (double) bed frame, giving your growing child a familiar and comfortable sleep space for years to come.

The kit includes everything you need: side rails, hardware, and instructions for a straightforward installation. Crafted from solid wood with a beautiful finish that matches your French Country furniture, the rails integrate seamlessly with the existing headboard and footboard from your crib conversion. Moving from toddler bed to full-size (double) bed is an exciting milestone, and this kit makes it feel like a natural progression.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
